versions.changelog:
Initial release of gaimode - Google AI Mode Search skill.

- Enables Google AI search directly from any OpenClaw agent using your local Google cookies.
- Provides live access to sports scores, stock prices, news, weather, and AI-powered web search.
- Simple setup with Playwright and a one-command API.
- Ensures privacy: cookie files are stored locally and never uploaded.
- Includes CLI tool for search queries and status checks.
